craft_notes: Sthāyin: set-up-gods (installed, unfulfilling). Rows: row 2 (unfulfilled→mother?). Close: mother (prasūte as landing: what does Māyā NOT mother — verb closes). Rejected: 'idols are empty' preached — kept cry kept (hā hā as the seers' own verdict); 'ignorance' for delusion — kept delusion (moha active).

lines: Gods installed in metal-pictures — seeing them, 'alas, alas' cry the unfulfilled:
body-proud body-bearers — what folly does Māyā not mother?
l4.sanskrit_cite: lohālekhyasthāpitān vīkṣya devān | hā hā hantetyāhureke'kṛtārthāḥ | dehāhantāśālināṃ dehabhājāṃ | mohāveśaṃ kaṃ na māyā prasūte

reads_against.argmap: What of set-up gods? → Installed images leave seers unfulfilled: body-I-ness breeds every delusion.
